method.elapsed_clock: cumulative CSV FrameTime, relative to capture start, not world/actor time
method.physics_interpretation: individual CPU scope durations; nested scopes and task-worker aggregates overlap and MUST NOT be summed as wall time
method.privacy: allowlisted footer fields only; command line, device/login IDs and event text omitted
method.late_scope_columns: use final header; earlier absent values are zero, matching UE writer semantics

run_alignment.interpretation: Wall-clock timestamp offset between two log entries, not an exact actor/world-time measurement. Selection is capture-relative; no offset correction applied.

validation.count_scope: Legacy assertion at run end; requested count is not an independently sampled per-frame count.
